title: Who Is Prioritized? Current Need versus Predicted Gains in China's Dibao Allocation: Evidence from a Revealed-Allocation Model
abstract: arXiv:2609.08411v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Using the 2017--2021 China Household Finance Survey panel and a sample of 3,102 households that did not receive Dibao in 2017, this paper applies the BBK revealed-allocation model to examine how household economic circumstances and predicted policy gains explain observed Dibao receipt in China. We find that household income is the allocation criterion most difficult to substitute with other factors. When all gain-adjustment terms are positive, constraining the income-rank coefficient to be nonnegative reduces the model's original improvement in fit by approximately 33.6\%; by contrast, setting both predicted-gain coefficients for food consumption and education spending to zero still preserves approximately 95.6\% of that improvement. These results indicate that observed Dibao allocation places greater emphasis on prioritizing households facing current livelihood hardship than on pursuing predictable short-run improvements in expendit

translated_title: 谁被优先？中国低保分配中的当期需求与预期收益：来自显性分配模型的证据
translated_abstract: 本文使用2017—2021年中国家庭金融调查（CHFS）面板数据，并以2017年未获得低保的3,102户家庭为样本，应用BBK显性分配模型，考察家庭经济状况与预期的政策收益如何解释实际观察到的低保获得情况。研究发现，家庭收入是最难被其他因素替代的分配标准。当所有收益调整项均为正时，将收入排序系数约束为非负会使模型原有的拟合改善幅度下降约33.6%；相比之下，将食品消费和教育支出这两个预期收益系数设为零，仍能保留该改善幅度的约95.6%。这些结果表明，实际观察到的低保分配更侧重于优先照顾面临当前生计困难的家庭，而非追求短期内可预期的支出改善。
tldr: 本文利用中国家庭金融调查数据与BBK显性分配模型发现，中国低保分配更优先照顾当前面临生计困难的家庭，而非以短期内可预期的支出收益为导向。
en_tdlr: Using the BBK revealed-allocation model, this paper shows that China's Dibao allocation prioritizes households facing current livelihood hardship over predictable short-run gains in expenditure.
